“ I hope everyone sleeps soon so we get dream voyagers! „

Star Voyage Guide (Korean: 별여행 기차 안내원, byeol-yeohaeng gicha annaewon) is Candy Corn Cookie's second costume, released in the first half of the Voyage to the World of Dreams! update. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained by drawing it from the Vintage Costume Jar in the Gem Exchange Center.

Story

Beep beep! There's the signal! Candy Corn Cookie begins checking the tickets possessed by Cookies aboard the Star Voyage Express. No ticket? No problem! She kindly teaches confused dream voyagers how to imagine up their own. Close your eyes and imagine your ticket before heading the enchanting Milky Way Station for your very own trip!

Trivia

  • Star Voyage Guide was released alongside  Star Voyage Signalman,  Guide to Sweet Dreams,  Naptime Buddy,  Moonlight Express Engineer,  Moonlight Conductor,  Dreamy Cradle Crafter,  Buzzy Dreaming,  Dreamy Pie Pâtissière,  Dreamy Pie Bakery,  Dreamy Party Planner, and  Dreamy Party Guest.
  • Star Voyage Guide was originally obtainable by purchasing it from the Gem Exchange Center during the Voyage to the World of Dreams! update.

“ Beep beep! Pie delivery! „

Pie Delivery Scout (Korean:설레는 파이 배달부, seolleneun pai baedalbu, "Exciting Pie Delivery Person") is Candy Corn Cookie's first Costume, released accompanying her in the first half of the Our Special Pie Party! update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Candy Corn Cookie sets off on a delivery mission, carrying pies lovingly baked by Everything Pie Cookie. For any Cookie unable to attend the Pumpkin Moon Party, she'll go to the ends of Earthbread—by train or by boat—no distance is too far! If you're waiting with your window open and catch a whiff of sweetness, dash out quickly! A warm, freshly baked pie is sure to be waiting for you!

Trivia

  • Pie Delivery Scout was released alongside  Crow Wizard,  March to Dreamland,  Devilish Than a Devil,  Angelic Than an Angel,  Swashbuckling Pirate,  Happy Town Pie Crier,  Wizard's Apprentice,  Dreamland Lullaby,  Infernal Demon,  Flaming Angel, and  One-Eyed Pirate.
